review_type: Codex source-based manual delta review; not independent or official

prior_substituted_review.scope: v0.2.0 source package before complete model outcomes and post-hoc diagnostic

manual_delta_findings.status: supported for the revised coverage; no perfection claim
manual_delta_findings.evidence: Oracle and independent alternative pass 365/365. Nop remains reward 0. Thirty-two general scalar-conversion regressions detect the known functional error and preserve successful-call warning categories. All original cases and performance thresholds remain unchanged.
The minimally repaired Oracle and the unchanged independently implemented segment-tree alternative both pass every revised case under one CPU and 2 GiB.

The unchanged instruction explicitly requires release NumPy dtype arithmetic, negative/non-finite tolerance compatibility, and successful-call warning-category sets. Both new regression families enforce that existing contract; they add no solver-facing requirement.
API outcomes, exact integer counts, numeric scores, warnings and errors are checked through execution. Candidate source is neither searched nor restricted to a selected algorithm.

The original optimization remains the task. The small scalar-promotion defect is a real compatibility bug, but is not itself evidence of frontier-level professional difficulty. Thresholds and workloads were not tightened to force failures.

All six original trials received reward 1. One saved implementation now receives an offline semantic failure; the other five pass. This does not achieve the requested six legitimate reward-0 outcomes or prove the TB3 difficulty bar.
Prior art remains a reviewer concern; no new originality claim follows from a numerical regression. No new candidate search was started.

manual_delta_findings.status: supported by source and executed observations
manual_delta_findings.evidence: The existing harness and worker are byte-unchanged. Actual workers run as UID/GID 10001, clear groups and set NoNewPrivs; trusted grading and CTRF remain outside that user's access.
All nine control/regrade runs have 365 unique CTRF cases, consistent totals, no skipped/pending/other outcomes, and rewards exactly 0 or 1.

manual_delta_findings.status: valid network_mode retained; old raw review flag preserved
manual_delta_findings.evidence: Pinned Harbor parses network_mode=public and exposes the field in EnvironmentConfig. Its schema source hash is recorded. The old rubric inventory omits this supported field; no deprecated allow_internet field was introduced to satisfy it.

manual_delta_findings.status: noncompliant until the contributor authors the human-only sections
manual_delta_findings.evidence: The instruction and four explanation paragraphs remain explicitly AI-generated. Approval, factual edits and natural wording do not satisfy complete human authorship. Author metadata is unchanged and verified; no personal survival-analysis contribution is invented.
Source-level isolation is retained. Neither adversarial attempt produced a valid result. The provider-blocked prompt was not retried, rephrased or rerouted.

manual_delta_findings.status: prior source review retained; not a new hosted verdict
manual_delta_findings.evidence: The contract audit confirms identical instructions, runtime dependencies, Dockerfiles, transfer scope, worker, process controller, statistical/numerical limits, workloads, time budgets and resource settings. Only test coverage, the task version/README and the demonstrated reference warning defect changed.

overall: Adopt the corrected verifier as the stronger experimental artifact, while retaining explicit unmet authorship, difficulty/matrix, adversarial and official-review requirements.
